pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/browser_bridge/mcp.rs:420 a page tool's gate class is derived from reversible/side_effects the CALLING AGENT echoes in its own call args, not from the scanned or live manifest, so an agent passing reversible:true,side_effects:internal turns any un-overridden page tool to auto; the whitelist's tighten-only overrides (src/features/browser/whitelist/SitePolicyFields.tsx:11 'the class the page's own manifest implied') are the only brake and the operator is told the class comes from the page

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/browser_bridge/mcp.rs:420 the gated party supplies the input that decides whether the gate arms (the tool description at :290 claims the gate re-derives the class from the page's manifest)
src-tauri/src/browser_bridge/policy.rs:214 an operator override may only tighten the page-manifest (author-tier) class; a loosening override is refused loudly as refused_loosening

src-tauri/src/browser_bridge/policy.rs:144 the Whitelist row is re-read on every navigation, so the page's revoke controls (src/features/browser/whitelist/useWhitelistActions.ts:42 toggle, :79 delete) take effect at the gate; src-tauri/src/commands/companion/approvals/approval_exec_browser.rs:602 an agent's request may widen to one concrete origin only, never a pattern

pairs.registryProposal: Coverage gap in the PROJECT context map, not the corpus: src-tauri/src/browser_bridge/ (mcp.rs, policy.rs, backend.rs - the substrate that enforces this context's policy) belongs to no context, so no pair can be anchored on it directly; this verdict anchors there because the consequence lands on the policy this page curates. Upward note for gate-state-machines: a 'derive class from declared manifest flags' gate needs an explicit rule that the flags are read from the system's own capture (scan report or live page), never from the request echo.
